svg.aria-label: Agent Hub drawn as a circuit board, stacked for a narrow screen: devices connect through Tailscale to the Hub, which feeds one bus down the board into the autonomous LLM pipeline, PC control and the media tools. Skills feed OpenCode, the orchestrator works both ways with Dispatch and runs the agent team, and TALK joins the same bus.

loops until you apply or discard
